newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends below 4,000 as Dow slips again.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends below 4,000 as Dow slips again.

text.p: Continued worries about recent Wall Street falls saw UK shares retreat below the psychologically important 4,000 mark for the first time in two weeks in another unsettled session on Thursday. After opening steadily following well-received results from ICI, shares lost ground for the third consecutive day amid concern about U.S. weakness and a lack of upbeat news to sustain the market in record territory.
Since setting a new high of 4,073.2 on Monday, the market has struggled, finishing at 3,999.4, a fall of 29.0 points with losers leading gainers nearly two to one.
